description:
Use unified stored-text search inside one currently public meeting.

    Returns an optional current-text preview, without resolving timing. A text match
    can lack a literal preview; use get_meeting(include_transcript=true) for full source
    retrieval. This does not run a separate local scan or fuzzy passage ranking.
